title: kith-core: Message, DeliveryState, Attachment types
description:
What: Define Message, DeliveryState enum, and Attachment structs in src/message.rs.

Module file: crates/kith-core/src/message.rs — create this file, then add 'pub mod message;' to src/lib.rs.

Algorithm:
1. Define DeliveryState enum with variants Pending, Delivered, Failed, Received.
   Serde: rename_all = "snake_case" so they serialize as "pending", "delivered", etc.
   Derives: Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize.
2. Define Attachment struct with fields:
   blob_id: String  → #[serde(rename="blobId")]
   filename: String
   content_type: String  → #[serde(rename="contentType")]
   size: u64
   sha256: String
   Derives: Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize.
3. Define Message struct with fields:
   id: String  (ULID, time-sortable)
   chat_id: String  → #[serde(rename="chatId")]
   sender_id: String  → #[serde(rename="senderId")]
   body: String
   body_type: String  → #[serde(rename="bodyType")]
   attachments: Vec<Attachment>
   reply_to: Option<String>  → #[serde(rename="replyTo", skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")]
   sent_at: String  → #[serde(rename="sentAt")]  (RFC 3339, untrusted)
   received_at: String  → #[serde(rename="receivedAt")]  (RFC 3339, trusted)
   delivery_state: DeliveryState  → #[serde(rename="deliveryState")]
   delivered_at: Option<String>  → #[serde(rename="deliveredAt", skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")]
   read_at: Option<String>  → #[serde(rename="readAt", skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")]
   Derives: Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize.
4. Add 'pub mod message;' to src/lib.rs (only this one line — do not touch other mods).
5. Run: cargo check -p kith-core

Defensive programming rules:
- sentAt is display-only; receivedAt is authoritative for ordering — document this in a comment
- No validation of body size in kith-core types (validation happens at boundary in kith-peer/kith-chat)
- All Option<String> fields use skip_serializing_if to avoid null in output

Tests (independent oracle: manual construction from RFC 8620 field names):
- Round-trip test: construct a Message with all fields set, serialize to JSON string, deserialize back, assert equality
- DeliveryState test: serialize each variant, assert matches expected string
- Optional field test: serialize Message with reply_to=None, assert JSON has no replyTo key
